author: Screen Junkies
description:
Who will win this year’s Oscar for Best Picture? One Battle After Another, Sinners, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, Sentimental Value, The Secret Agent, Bugonia, Train Dreams, F1, or Frankenstein? It’s anybody’s guess but if we have anything to say about it, this is No Holds Barred’s year to get the overdue recognition it deserves.
